topic: 中小学核心语法：非谓语动词全通关（Non-finite Verbs）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就像是动词的“变装秀”！在一个正规的英文单句中，只能有一个真正的动词做“主角”（谓语）。如果其他动词也想出场，就必须穿上变装服——变成 To do（不定式）、Doing（动名词/现在分词）或 Done（过去分词），不再充当谓语动词。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
- 一句不容二主动（无连词时不能有两个谓语）；
- To do 往往表“将来、目的与未发生”；
- Doing 往往表“主动、正在与日常习惯”；
- Done 往往表“被动与已完成”。
3. 【避坑指南】：
- 易错1：双谓语叠加（如 *I like play football* ❌ -> I like playing football ✔️）；
- 易错2：分词作状语时逻辑主语不一致（如 *Walking in the park, the weather was nice* ❌）；
- 易错3：混淆 stop to do（停下正在做的事去干另一件事）与 stop doing（彻底停止当前动作）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- She decided to study hard for the upcoming English exam.（她决定努力复习准备即将到来英语考试。）
- Swimming every morning keeps my grandfather healthy.（每天早晨游泳保持了我爷爷的健康。）
- Encouraged by his teacher, Tom made rapid progress.（受到老师的鼓励，汤姆取得了飞速进步。）

questions.question: Tom wants ______ a new bicycle for his 10th birthday.
questions.explanation: 考查 want 的固定搭配：want to do sth. 表示“想要做某事”，使用不定式作宾语。

questions.question: My little sister enjoys ______ storybooks before going to sleep every night.
questions.explanation: 考查 enjoy 的固定用法：enjoy doing sth. 表示“喜欢/享受做某事”，后接动名词形式。

questions.question: Don't forget ______ off the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“忘记去做某事（事情尚未做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事”。根据句意，离开教室前“不要忘记去关灯”，故用 to turn。

questions.question: The English teacher made all of us ______ the poem together in class.
questions.explanation: 考查使役动词 make 的用法：make sb. do sth. 表示“让某人做某事”，接不带 to 的动词不定式（动词原形）。

questions.question: The water in the river is too cold for the children ______ swimming today.
questions.explanation: 考查 too... to... 结构，意为“太……以至于不能做某事”，用不定式 to go 补充完整。

questions.question: Please stop ______ so much noise! The baby is fast asleep in the next room.
questions.explanation: stop doing sth. 表示“停止正在做的事”；stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去干另一件事”。此处指“停止制造噪音”，故选 making。

questions.question: Tim practices ______ the piano for an hour after finishing his homework.
questions.explanation: 考查 practice 的固定搭配：practice doing sth. 表示“练习做某事”，后接动名词。

questions.question: Our class decided ______ the museum this Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 考查 decide 的固定搭配：decide to do sth. 表示“决定做某事”。

questions.question: My mother let me ______ TV for thirty minutes after dinner.
questions.explanation: 考查使役动词 let 的搭配：let sb. do sth. 意为“允许/让某人做某事”，后跟省略 to 的不定式。

questions.question: ______ English every morning is a very good habit for language learners.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词作句子的主语。当单个动作作为主语时，需用 V-ing 形式（Reading）。

questions.question: Li Lei works very hard at school in order ______ good marks in the final exams.
questions.explanation: 考查目的状语短语 in order to do sth.，意为“为了达到……目的”，后面使用动词原形 get。

questions.question: How about ______ to the newly opened park with us this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 考查介词后接动名词：How about / What about 后的 about 是介词，后接 V-ing 形式。

questions.question: It is important for primary students ______ a balanced diet every day.
questions.explanation: 考查经典句型“It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.”，其中 It 为形式主语，真正的动词主语是不定式短语 to keep...

questions.question: I remembered ______ the door before leaving, so nobody can get inside.
questions.explanation: remember doing sth. 表示“记得做过某事（已完成）”。根据句意，我已经记得把门锁过了，故选 locking。

questions.question: He spent two hours ______ his lost keys yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 考查 spend 的固定用法：spend time (in) doing sth. 表示“花费时间做某事”，后接 V-ing。

questions.question: ______ from the peak of the mountain, the whole city looks extraordinarily beautiful at night.
questions.explanation: 考查分词作状语。句子主语 the whole city 与 see 之间是被动关系（城市是被看），因此应用过去分词 Seen。

questions.question: ______ all his assignments ahead of time, David went out to play basketball with confidence.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词的完成式。David 与 finish 是主动关系，且“完成作业”发生在“去打篮球”之前，故用 Having finished 作状语。

questions.question: The international conference ______ in Shanghai next month will focus on artificial intelligence.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式作后置定语。next month 表将来，conference 与 hold 为被动关系，故用不定式的被动形式 to be held。

questions.question: With all the preparations ______, the host announced the opening of the 2026 Cultural Festival.
questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构：with + 宾语 + 宾补。preparations 与 complete 是被动与完成关系，故选用过去分词 completed。

questions.question: I noticed a suspicious man ______ into the building through the broken side window just now.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词 notice 的用法：notice sb. do sth. 表示注意到动作的全过程，后接省略 to 的动词不定式（原形）。

questions.question: This historic wooden temple urgently needs ______ before the heavy rain season arrives.
questions.explanation: 考查 need 表示“需要被做”时的特殊用法：need doing = need to be done。这里 repairing 用主动形式表达被动含义。

questions.question: ______ by the unexpected good news, the whole family burst into tears of joy.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作原因状语。主语 the whole family 与 shock 为被动关系（被震惊），指人感到震惊用 Shocked。

questions.question: The doctor strongly advised the patient to avoid ______ food containing high levels of refined sugar.
questions.explanation: 考查 avoid 的固定用词规则：avoid doing sth. 表示“避免做某事”，需后接动名词作宾语。

questions.question: Rather than ______ in the long queue at the ticket room, we preferred to purchase the tickets online.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型 rather than do A, prefer to do B（宁愿做B也不愿做A）。rather than 后跟不带 to 的动词原形 wait。

questions.question: The suspect was seen ______ out of the bank with a black briefcase late last night.
questions.explanation: 感官动词在主动语态中省略 to（see sb. do），但变被动语态时必须补全 to，即 be seen to do sth.。

questions.question: ______ severe criticism from his manager, the assistant decided to hand in his resignation.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词完成式。助手主动遭受（suffer）批评，且“遭受批评”发生在“递交辞呈”之前，故选 Having suffered。

questions.question: There are still many critical issues ______ before the agreement can be officially signed.
questions.explanation: 考查 there be 句型中的非谓语作定语。issues（问题）在将来“有待被解决”，表示被动与尚未发生，故用 to be settled。

questions.question: ______ no further business to discuss, the chairperson declared the annual meeting closed.
questions.explanation: 考查独立主格结构。原句为 There be 句型，在非谓语从属结构中，be 动词变成 being，保留引导词 there，构成“There being...”

questions.question: The boy pretended ______ what his mother said, but actually he paid close attention to every word.
questions.explanation: 考查 pretend 的搭配及其否定形式：pretend to do sth. 的否定式直接在 to 前加 not，即 pretend not to do sth.。

questions.question: The keynote speaker delivered a powerful speech, ______ the audience to strive for their dreams.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词作伴随或结果状语。演讲者做演讲，伴随并自然导致了激励听众的结果，使用动名词/现在分词 inspiring。
